changelog:
Initial release of google-ads-open-cli skill.

- Enables Google Ads data analysis and reporting using a read-only CLI.
- Supports account exploration, campaign/ad group/keyword stats, conversion audits, and custom GAQL queries.
- Provides detailed guidance on authentication, account hierarchy, money values, and output formats.
- Includes usage examples and command references for browsing entities and retrieving performance stats.
- Allows execution of arbitrary GAQL queries with syntax reference and common metrics.
summary: Google Ads data analysis and reporting via google-ads-open-cli. Use when the user wants to check Google Ads performance, pull campaign/ad group/keyword stats...
